usage: The word '餸' refers to a side dish served with rice or main meals in Cantonese cuisine.
It is used to describe any cooked dish, usually including meat, vegetables, or seafood, that accompanies plain rice.
'餸' can appear before or after quantifiers to indicate amounts, for example, '一碟餸' (a plate of side dish).
When ordering at a restaurant, '餸' is commonly used to refer to dishes besides staple food while eating.
'餸' is not usually used alone to mean a whole meal, but specifically focuses on the dishes served alongside.
